tools.name: av_actress_search
tools.description: Search AV actress records by name, measurements, birthday, cup, blood type, or page.

b.description: Bust: [N] exact, or [min, max] inclusive range; 0 means unbounded (e.g. [80, 0] = 80 and above). Actresses without data are excluded.

cups.description: Multiple cups, matches any of them, e.g. ["A", "B", "D"]. Can be combined with cup.

h.description: Hips: [N] exact, or [min, max] inclusive range; 0 means unbounded (e.g. [80, 0] = 80 and above). Actresses without data are excluded.

height.description: Height: [N] exact, or [min, max] inclusive range; 0 means unbounded (e.g. [80, 0] = 80 and above). Actresses without data are excluded.

name.description: Actress name or kana, partial match; exact match ranks first.

w.description: Waist: [N] exact, or [min, max] inclusive range; 0 means unbounded (e.g. [80, 0] = 80 and above). Actresses without data are excluded.

tools.name: av_actress_submission_status
tools.description: Check whether an av_actress_submit submission is pending, approved, or rejected (with the rejection reason).

tools.name: av_actress_submit
tools.description: Submit a new AV actress, or an edit to an existing one, for admin review. Approved data appears in av_actress_search. For kind=edit, only the fields you pass are changed; other fields keep their current values. Creating an actress whose name already exists returns the existing ones as duplicates; the admin may merge the submission into them.

aliases.description: Other stage names (not including name). DMM credits like "Name（Alias、Alias）" list them in brackets.

cup.description: Cup size: AAA, AA, or A-Z.

kind.description: create a new actress, or edit an existing one.

links.description: Reference links shown on the actress page (official X, agency profile, etc.).

title.description: Optional label; the domain is shown when empty.

target.description: Required for edit: the actress name, or "domain-aid" (e.g. "xcity-1234", "manual-56") when several actresses share the name.

tools.name: av_video_search
tools.description: Search AV video records by keyword, tags, actress, maker, label, series, director, video number, date, or page. Set facets=true to also get the most common tags/makers/series/actresses (with counts) under the same conditions, useful for narrowing down.

actress.description: Exact actress name filter. A string, or an array of names that must all appear (co-starring, AND).

director.description: Exact director filter. A string, or an array where any one matches (OR).

duration_min.description: Minimum duration in minutes. Videos without duration data are excluded when set.

facets.description: Also return facets (top tags 15, makers/series/actresses 10 each, with counts) for the same conditions. Defaults to false.

keyword.description: Keyword: phrase match on title, partial (substring) match on actresses, series, makers, directors, labels and tags. Use the exact filters (actress, series, maker, ...) when the full name is known.

label.description: Exact label filter. A string, or an array where any one matches (OR).

maker.description: Exact maker filter. A string, or an array where any one matches (OR).

release.description: Release state. released (default): already on sale; upcoming: pre-orders with a future release date (next 30 days); all: both.

series.description: Exact series filter. A string, or an array where any one matches (OR).

sort.description: Sort by release date. Defaults to newest.

tag.description: Exact tag filter. A string, or an array of strings that must all match (AND).

tools.name: av_video_submission_status
tools.description: Check whether an av_video_submit submission is pending, approved, or rejected (with the rejection reason).

tools.name: av_video_submit
tools.description: Submit an edit to an existing AV video for admin review. Approved changes appear in av_video_search and are kept across DMM re-syncs. Only the fields you pass are changed; other fields keep their current values. Videos cannot be created. Tags must be existing DMM tags (use av_video_search facets to find them). The result lists new_values: values no other video has yet, check them for typos. Shares the hourly submission limit with av_actress_submit.

actresses.description: Full cast list (replaces the current list). Stage names or DMM credits like "Name（Alias）".

directors.description: Full director list (replaces the current list).

labels.description: Full label list (replaces the current list).

links.description: Reference links shown on the video page (replaces the current list).

title.description: Optional label; the domain is shown when empty.

maker_no.description: Maker product code (e.g. "MDVR-448"); enables the MissAV link and becomes the page URL.

makers.description: Full maker list (replaces the current list).

series.description: Full series list (replaces the current list).

tags.description: Full tag list (replaces the current list); existing DMM tags only.

target.description: The video to edit: maker product code (e.g. "MDVR-448") or DMM internal no (e.g. "mdvr00448"). Use the internal no when a product code matches several videos.

tools.name: ping
tools.description: Return a basic liveness response from the MCP server.
